title: lablab purpureus var. rhomboideus
intro: Lablab purpureus var. rhomboideus, commonly known as the Indian lablab or flat-podded lablab, is a variant of the lablab bean (Lablab purpureus) that is widely cultivated for its edible beans and leaves. The lablab bean is believed to have several health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of lablab purpureus var. rhomboideus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of lablab purpureus var. rhomboideus are also reported to have antimicrobial, anticancer, and hepatoprotective properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various diseases.
